name: No-dong warhead
source: 1000.00 kg payload, carried as payload_kg in the 'No-dong' booster file until 2026-09-03, when the booster library became stack-only; the number's own source is not recorded there. Separating. beta_kg_m2 = 3653.7 kg/m2 is DERIVED, not documented: m / (Cd * pi D^2/4) with Cd = 0.200 read from the booster's own stored drag table at the reference Mach 5 (the codebase's GLIDE_MACH_REF convention) and D = 1.320 m, the last stage's diameter — i.e. it reproduces the pre-migration behaviour of flying the payload with the stage's drag. length_m 0 = not recorded.
notes: [2026-09-03] Created by the payload migration. RECONSTRUCTION: no payload-specific geometry is recorded; replace beta/shape/length when a source is found. Ballistic (no lift).
